SME-CAPEX-001.focus_group:
### 🗣️ Synthetic Focus Group Debate: Service Van Expansion

1. The Cost-Conscious Skeptic (Frank, 67):
“I don’t care if they have a new van. If they charge me $300 just to turn up and clear a drain, I’ll find a guy with a hand-snake on Craigslist. They need to keep rates reasonable.”

2. The Convenience-Driven Advocate (Sarah, 42):
“Frank, when my commercial kitchen sink backs up on a Friday night, I don’t have time to wait three days. I lose $2,000 in dinner sales! I gladly pay a premium to a company that actually has an assistant tech and a jetter van ready to arrive in under an hour.”

3. The Pragmatic Local Tech-Adopter (Marcus, 31):
“Exactly. If I can book them on my phone, get a GPS tracker showing when the van is arriving, and get a video inspection of my line, they've got my business. Demand is high here because nobody else answers their phones.”

Consensus Demand Index Score: 78
Consumer Sentiment Verdict: GO (Strong demand for premium response times)
SME-CAPEX-001.executive_report:
EXECUTIVE REPORT (OFFLINE SIMULATOR - llama3.2:latest fallback):

This CapEx expansion is highly recommended. Expanding the physical fleet directly addresses your current capacity bottleneck. The projected financial return yields a robust forward NPV, easily outpacing your 7% hurdle rate. While hiring risks exist, the cost of inaction (losing commercial market share to faster competitors) is significantly higher. Proceed with the purchase.

SME-SUNK-002.focus_group:
### 🗣️ Synthetic Focus Group Debate: Custom E-Commerce Platform

1. The Cost-Conscious Skeptic (Frank, 67):
“Why are you spending all this money on a custom website? Just list your boutique items on Facebook Marketplace or eBay. It's free!”

2. The Convenience-Driven Advocate (Sarah, 42):
“No way, Frank. I want to buy local gifts directly from their site, but last week I tried to checkout and the basket kept glitching. I got frustrated and just ordered from Amazon instead. If they don't fix those bugs, they are actively losing my money.”

3. The Pragmatic Local Tech-Adopter (Marcus, 31):
“If a local shop has a broken checkout, they don't exist to me. But honestly, why are they paying an agency thousands to build a custom system? They should drop this custom code and just move to Shopify. I want Apple Pay and instant tracking, not a buggy form.”

Consensus Demand Index Score: 42
Consumer Sentiment Verdict: NO-GO (High customer friction; recommend moving to standard turnkey instead of paying more agency fees)
SME-SUNK-002.executive_report:
EXECUTIVE REPORT (OFFLINE SIMULATOR - llama3.2:latest fallback):

This decision presents a classic sunk-cost trap. While the legacy $18,000 spend is painful to look at, it is completely irrelevant to the forward decision. The fresh $6,500 investment yields a highly positive forward-looking return. Do not abandon the project out of emotional exhaustion; spend the $6,500 to capture the asset's digital sales pipeline, but place strict milestones on the agency.

SME-AI-003.focus_group:
### 🗣️ Synthetic Focus Group Debate: Automated Review & Text-Back System

1. The Cost-Conscious Skeptic (Frank, 67):
“I don't like getting automated texts. It feels robotic. But I guess if I call and can't get through, a text back is better than dead silence.”

2. The Convenience-Driven Advocate (Sarah, 42):
“Are you kidding? If I call a service shop and they don't answer, I hang up and immediately call the next competitor on Google. If I get an instant text saying 'Hey, we're on a job, text us your issue here,' I stop searching! That instantly rescues my business.”

3. The Pragmatic Local Tech-Adopter (Marcus, 31):
“100% true. And as for the reviews, I only trust local businesses that have multiple recent 5-star ratings on Google Maps. If they text me a direct link right after finishing a clean job, I'll happily tap 5 stars. It's how I choose who to hire.”

Consensus Demand Index Score: 89
Consumer Sentiment Verdict: GO (Incredibly high demand pull; solves a massive customer friction point)
SME-AI-003.executive_report:
EXECUTIVE REPORT (OFFLINE SIMULATOR - llama3.2:latest fallback):

This automation workflow represents an exceptional high-impact opportunity. For a minor upfront setup cost, you plug a structural revenue leak (missed inbound calls) and compound your organic search positioning via automated review captures. The simple payback is measured in months. Approve the deployment immediately.
